references.text: Jesus commands the disciples to get into a boat, and a storm arises while they are on the sea, demonstrating Jesus' power over nature.
Immediately after feeding the five thousand, Jesus makes the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, parallel to the event in Matthew.
A similar event where Jesus performs a miracle with food and then involves the disciples in a situation on the water.
The disciples are on the sea without Jesus, and he walks on the water to meet them, demonstrating his authority over the forces of nature.
